requirements.title: CFI_establish has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h descriptor-establishment interface
requirements.definition: CFI_establish has the interface int CFI_establish(CFI_cdesc_t *dv, void *base_addr, CFI_attribute_t attribute, CFI_type_t type, size_t elem_len, CFI_rank_t rank, const CFI_index_t extents[]) and establishes a C descriptor.

pending.CFI_establish-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares CFI_CDESC_T storage, and compiles ordinary CFI_establish calls for null and nonnull base_addr cases.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future mixed Fortran/C fixtures compile a C companion with the processor ISO_Fortran_binding.h, link it with a Fortran driver through the existing C interoperability harness, and assert only portable descriptor members, pointer equality or address differences computed from descriptor storage strides, CFI_SUCCESS equal to zero, named CFI error macros by identity rather than numeric value, and exact integer/logical status results. Numeric values of error macros other than CFI_SUCCESS, C object padding, alignment choices beyond successful creation, allocation addresses, and selection among several detected errors remain processor latitude.

requirements.title: CFI_establish actual arguments must satisfy descriptor storage, base, attribute, type, length, rank, and extent restrictions
requirements.definition: The descriptor storage, base address, attribute code, type code, element length, rank, and extents arguments shall satisfy the stated validity, aliasing, alignment, allocatable, character-length, rank-range, and nonnegative-extent requirements.

pending.CFI_establish-dv-storage-and-aliasing: Positive C companion declares CFI_CDESC_T(2) local storage, casts its address to CFI_cdesc_t *, and uses it only outside any active Fortran descriptor argument association.
pending.CFI_establish-base-address-null-or-align: Use an int array object for the nonnull base_addr positive control and NULL for the allocatable positive control; misaligned storage remains a nonconforming source-control negative.
pending.CFI_establish-attribute-code-validity: Call CFI_establish separately with CFI_attribute_other over int storage, CFI_attribute_pointer over int storage, and CFI_attribute_allocatable with NULL base_addr; assert CFI_SUCCESS in all three.
pending.CFI_establish-type-code-validity: Use CFI_type_int for int storage and CFI_type_char for character storage; invalid type-code probes are nonconforming and compare only named CFI_INVALID_TYPE under a diagnostic profile.
pending.CFI_establish-elem-len-validity: For CFI_type_char pass elem_len 5 and for CFI_type_struct pass sizeof(struct pair); noncharacter CFI_type_int companion passes elem_len 0 and does not assert elem_len effects from that ignored argument.
pending.CFI_establish-rank-range: Use ranks 0, 1, and 2 within CFI_MAX_RANK; rank CFI_MAX_RANK plus one is a nonconforming diagnostic-profile probe comparing only CFI_INVALID_RANK after detection.
pending.CFI_establish-extents-validity: For nonnull rank-two base pass extents {2,3} and assert descriptor extents 2 and 3; null-base and rank-zero companions pass NULL extents and assert CFI_SUCCESS.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_establish creates the descriptor state described by its arguments
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_establish updates dv to describe a nonallocatable nonpointer object of known shape, an unallocated allocatable object, or a data pointer; pointer lower bounds are zero for nonnull base_addr, null base_addr yields the stated unallocated, disassociated, or no-object descriptor states, Fortran-object arguments must be type-consistent, and other properties come from the remaining arguments.

pending.CFI_establish-known-shape-or-allocatable: C companion establishes CFI_attribute_other over int storage with extents {2,3}, CFI_attribute_allocatable with NULL base, and CFI_attribute_pointer over int storage; assert CFI_SUCCESS and the descriptor rank, type, attribute, base_addr, and extents expected for each.
pending.CFI_establish-pointer-lower-bounds-zero: Pointer companion establishes rank-one int storage with extent 4 and attribute CFI_attribute_pointer, then asserts dim[0].lower_bound equals 0 and CFI_address subscript {0} points to the first element.
pending.CFI_establish-null-base-descriptor-state: Allocatable NULL-base companion asserts base_addr remains NULL and attribute is CFI_attribute_allocatable; pointer NULL-base companion asserts base_addr NULL and attribute CFI_attribute_pointer; other NULL-base companion is used only as result storage for CFI_section.
pending.CFI_establish-fortran-object-type-consis: Mixed Fortran/C companion passes a Fortran integer(c_int) array descriptor to C only after a BIND(C) interface declares matching integer(c_int) type; a mismatched CFI_type_double mutation is a source-control negative without required diagnosis.
pending.CFI_establish-properties-from-arguments: Rank-two int companion passes type CFI_type_int, attribute CFI_attribute_other, rank 2, and extents {2,3}; after CFI_SUCCESS assert descriptor members match those argument-controlled properties.

requirements.title: Detected CFI_establish errors preserve the descriptor object
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_establish error, the object at dv is not modified.

pending.CFI_establish-detected-error-preserves-d: Invalid-rank preservation has no portable oracle: 18.5.4 p4 defines CFI_rank_t as a standard integer type capable of representing the largest supported rank, not a signed integer type, so rank -1 cannot be portably supplied; rank CFI_MAX_RANK + 1 can be unrepresentable in CFI_rank_t and 18.5.5.5 p2 also requires dv to address storage large enough for the specified rank. A future processor-profile test may snapshot descriptor storage and assert CFI_INVALID_RANK plus unchanged members only after the profile proves a representable isolated invalid rank and adequate descriptor storage.

requirements.title: CFI_establish returns an error indicator
requirements.definition: The result of CFI_establish is an error indicator.

pending.CFI_establish-result-error-indicator: Valid CFI_establish companions assert the int result equals CFI_SUCCESS and CFI_SUCCESS equals zero. The invalid-rank result case has no portable oracle because 18.5.4 p4 does not require CFI_rank_t to be signed for rank -1, and rank CFI_MAX_RANK + 1 can be unrepresentable and would also require descriptor storage large enough for that specified rank under 18.5.5.5 p2.
